Every board starts from a hole from which you can end with a single marble, and a live indicator tells you whether that is still possible. Six boards (English cross, French cross, small cross, pyramid, asymmetric, hexagon), 30 star-rated puzzles on seven boards, unlimited undo. New: a hint that shows the next good move, a 37-hole hexagonal board where you also jump diagonally, and a glass sulphide to win for each puzzle solved (30 to collect in a showcase).
